### Key Implementation Details

The root cause was the JSONB codec in `_init_connection` (set with `encoder=json.dumps`), which double-encodes payloads as string scalars:
- Payload object `{"target": "..."}` → JSON string → JSONB string scalar
- Original query couldn't extract target with `->>'target'` on string scalars
- Solution: Normalize both shapes in SQL using CTE before extraction

The fix is backward-compatible:
- Existing string-encoded payloads still work
- New object payloads also work
- Single event per link maintained (no observable behavior change)
